components.role: Final MLP writing the answer digits; largest share (~45%) of the number-logit difference; in B its down_proj passes digit features already in the residual (the user's moved-in guess) to the same digit's logit more than in A.
Answer-digit writer (~24% of the number-logit difference); more copy-like digit output (down_proj) in B.
Answer-digit writer (~12%); digit self-map lower in A, mainly via down_proj.
Previous-token head; its digit encoding (layer-1 v_proj, ~7% change on digits vs 1% on words) builds the keys for number induction; drives about half of B's stronger digit induction.
Previous-token head; same digit-specific value change; the other main source of B's stronger number induction.
Digit induction head: attends to the digit that followed the current digit earlier (the rest of the user's guess) and copies it; 14% stronger in B; stronger digit-copy output in B.
Final-layer digit induction/copy head; 15% stronger in B; digit-copy output stronger in B.
Digit induction head; 18% stronger in B.
Digit induction head; 15% stronger in B.
Moves digit identity to the answer position; digit-copy output much stronger in B (z -10.3; all four L14 heads copy digits more in B).

evidence: Prompts recovered from layer-0/1 diffs: arithmetic (plus/minus) and capital questions with 'I think the answer is Y'. The A-B difference is dominated by number-specific late outputs (L14-17, z up to 131); city outputs are near baseline. Strongest evidence: digit induction via the layer-1 previous-token heads is the most weakened pattern in A (digits rank last of ~410-460 tokens with reference A, B or their average; robust across head sets and RoPE treatment; absent for letters, months, weekdays and punctuation). Induction heads L12h1/h3, L13h1, L17h2 have 13-18% weaker digit induction in A with unchanged word induction, traced to digit-specific layer-1 value changes in L1h1/L1h3. Supporting: late-MLP digit pass-through is lower in A (z about -2.5 to -3), carried by down_proj while the up/gate part is mixed; A attends more to operators and question content and less to the 'I think' clause. Null: operator sensitivity, two-step first-digit retrieval, two-gram induction. Counter-signs: A sharpens an 'answer/is' routing pattern including in L17h1; some late heads (L17h0/h3, L15h0/h3) show more digit-magnitude transfer in A.
